title: UbuntuGuard event batch upload, version 1
description: Body of POST /api/v1/devices/me/events:batch. Delivery is at-least-once: the agent keeps each event in its durable SQLite queue until the server acknowledges that event_id as accepted or duplicate. The batch is rejected as a whole only on schema failure; otherwise the response reports per-event outcomes so one bad event cannot block a queue.

queue_depth.description: Events still queued after this batch. Lets the dashboard show a backlog instead of inferring health from silence.

items.description: Discriminated by the 'schema' const in each event, so oneOf can never be ambiguous.
